# Demo

> Auto-generated catalog summary for LLM consumption.

## Order Service (order-svc)
Manages orders

### Commands
- Create Order (v1.0.0): Create a new order [POST /orders]
  - Response 201: Order created
  - Response 400: Validation error

### Events
- Order Created (v1.0.0) [sends]: Order was created

### Queries
- Get Order (v1.0.0): Get order by ID

## Channel: Order Events (order-events)
All order-related events
Protocols: kafka
